rationale: 編集用プレビューで4種類の生活資源の境遇を均衡よく確認する。史料上の人口比・出生比ではない。

sampling_policy.scenario_selection: Select the birth year first, then one of eight broad world regions. No historical/modern era bucket is selected as a life phase. The broad-region weights are authored game-balance weights, not empirical population shares.
sampling_policy.year_selection: Uniform across the rolling 2,000-calendar-year window for editor preview (27-2026 when reference year is 2026); not a historical birth-year distribution.
sampling_policy.resource_and_archetype_independence: Assumed for preview only. Replace with conditional estimates when source data allow.
sampling_policy.birth_status_distribution: The listed archetype weights are authoring priors for narrative variety, except where a source note says they borrow a household-level pattern. They are not observed shares of births.

jp_historical.source_note: A combined early-period household-class distribution for two Nihonmatsu villages is 74.8% titled peasant, 23.2% mizunomi, 2.1% other, excluding unknowns. The 75/23/2 authoring prior borrows this household pattern as a loose reference only; it does not estimate Niita births and does not cover 1720-1870 uniformly.
jp_historical.confidence: low; apply sensitivity range of ±15 percentage points to the landholding share

cn_historical.confidence: very low; not a population estimate
